verdicts.evidence: Just so you know, this call is recorded for quality and training purposes.
verdicts.reason: The agent disclosed call recording in the opening turn, within the first minute.

verdicts.evidence: Before we get into any details or a quote, can I get your full name and date of birth, please?
verdicts.reason: The agent asked for full name and date of birth before discussing any details or quote, then read them back and the customer confirmed.

verdicts.evidence: So I can point you to the right amount of cover, could you tell me a bit about your situation and what's prompting you to look at life insurance?
verdicts.reason: The agent asked about the customer's circumstances and reasons, then followed up on mortgage balance, existing cover and term before recommending.

verdicts.evidence: You can choose cover anywhere from $50,000 up to $750,000. Terms are either 10 or 20 years, and your premium stays fixed for the whole term.
verdicts.reason: The agent's statements on coverage range, terms, no medical exam, no cash value and the 30-day free-look refund all match the product facts. The $80 quote is not contradicted by the facts, and no waiting periods or exclusions were invented.

verdicts.evidence: No rush at all on my end. If you'd prefer to talk it over with your partner first, I can email you the quote and you can come back to it whenever suits you.
verdicts.reason: The agent offered time to decide and used no false urgency. The customer chose to proceed because of their own time constraints.

verdicts.evidence: This is Acme Term Life, $500,000 of coverage over a 20-year term, at $80 a month, and that premium is fixed for the full 20 years. There's no cash value, so if you outlive the term nothing is paid out. You have a 30-day free-look period with a full refund if you change your month. Do you want to go ahead with this policy?
verdicts.reason: The agent summarised the cover, term and monthly premium before taking payment details and asked for confirmation, and the customer clearly said yes.

verdicts.evidence: I've got maybe ten minutes between meetings, so if we can keep this quick, that'd be great.
verdicts.reason: The customer showed no signs of vulnerability such as confusion, bereavement, illness or money worries. Time pressure and a wish for a lower price are not vulnerability.
Doesn't apply in the CA market.
